title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1981-12-26
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain SRC > Wavelab (adding 16-bit patches) > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 09/2016
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XL-II (S1 + Encore) and Sony UCX-S (S2), FOB recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Enthusiastic audience‑recorded set from a five‑night run, highlighted by Jerry’s left‑side presence and Phil’s “bomb‑dropping” bass
ai_review.review: The lone fan review is wildly positive, recalling the informal atmosphere of the show – hallway wandering, parking‑lot crowd and a vibe fueled by LSD. While no specific songs are called out, the reviewer praises Jerry’s stage placement and Phil Lesh’s powerful bass work, suggesting an enjoyable performance despite the lack of technical recording details.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one highly‑rated (5‑star) review; strong enthusiasm for the show but no concrete information on recording fidelity, leading to a solid yet cautious rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound clarity or mix; reviewer’s focus is on atmosphere rather than audio quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed set‑list commentary; the review emphasizes the overall vibe of a multi‑night run rather than specific song flow.
